privileged_info_for_vlm: The template must be titled 'Incident Template' and tagged 'Security Incident'. It must have fields status=Open and severity=Triage. The button must be titled '$:/custom/buttons/NewIncident', tagged '$:/tags/PageControls', and have the caption 'New Incident'. The resulting incident tiddler must be titled 'New Security Incident'. The headings in the template must use the '#' character (Markdown style) exactly as specified.
